input.stance: Build a simple web app first. It reaches users faster, costs less, and lets two people ship updates and learn quickly.

recommendation.choice: Simple responsive web app (later a PWA)
recommendation.why: One codebase runs on every operating system. You can deploy updates instantly, sharing has no install step, and getting feedback is cheap. A desktop app adds packaging, code signing, auto-update and multi-OS testing work that a two-person team can't afford.

options.name: Simple web app
options.for: Cheapest and fastest to ship. Works on any device, updates instantly, has built-in analytics, and moves easily to subscription billing.
options.against: Needs hosting and security work. Offline support is limited, and some freelancers distrust cloud storage of client data.

options.name: Desktop app (Electron/Tauri)
options.for: Works offline, can integrate with the OS for things like time tracking and tray icons, and keeps data local.
options.against: Needs signing, installers and auto-update. Must be tested on several OSes, discovery is harder, feedback loops are slower, and mobile isn't covered.

options.name: Web app now, wrap as desktop later
options.for: Validate demand first, then wrap the same code with Tauri if users ask for desktop features.
options.against: Some rework will be needed if deep OS features turn out to be core.

claims.text: Shipping a desktop app across platforms requires code signing certificates, such as Apple Developer at $99/yr and Windows signing certificates, which adds cost and friction.
Web apps let you deploy fixes to all users at once, without users needing to install updates.
The main task tools for freelancers, such as Trello, Todoist and Notion, started web-first or are mainly web-based.

risks: The web market for task tools is crowded, so you need a sharp freelancer-specific angle.
Over-building sync, offline and auth infrastructure before validating demand.
If offline or local time tracking is core, a web app may disappoint early users.
unknowns: Is offline use or deep OS integration, like automatic time tracking, core to your idea?
What are your team's existing skills: web or native?
How will you reach your first users and charge them?
input.would_change_my_mind: Evidence that your target freelancers need offline use, local-only data, or OS-level tracking as the core value.
